intro_text:
This report presents a comprehensive summary of your performance in the **Data Analysis** Assessment conducted by **Innomatics
Research Labs** on **23rd May 2026.** The assessment was designed to evaluate your technical knowledge, analytical thinking,
problem-solving ability, and practical understanding across key domains, including **Python Programming, EDA Foundations, Applied
EDA, MySQL & Power BI, and Aptitude**.
The report highlights your overall performance, module-wise strengths, and improvement areas, providing valuable insights to support
your continuous learning journey and career growth in the field of Data Analytics.
marks_benchmark_note: Important: Your performance is evaluated relative to all candidates across all branches of Innomatics Research Labs who appeared for the DataAnalysis Job Fitment Assessment. The benchmarks shown below indicate the score required to be among the top 10% in each module.
